principles: Cloudflare R2 remains the only storage layer for chunks, web builds, game files, manifests, screenshots, and CDN-served assets.
Catalyst never proxies or streams large game files.
Catalyst only signs short-lived R2 PUT and GET URLs after authentication, authorization, and ownership checks.
Private bucket objects are delivered with temporary signed URLs; public web builds and media use CDN URLs.

signedUrl.note: Catalyst Cache expiration is hour-based and maxes out at 48 hours, so signed URL session payloads include their own expiresAt timestamp for minute-level enforcement.
